tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// gtsug tor gdugs dkar can gyi 'khor lo bri thabs rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga dang bcas pa rig sngags grub pa nor bu'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nor bu'i gdengs ka las// ye shes rnam 'phrul nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid kyis// phas rgol mi mthun rgud pa'i mun pa 'jil mdzad pa// rig pa'i lha mo gdugs dkar can gyis dge legs mdzod// bstan dang bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gang zag la// gnod pa bzlog cing bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir// yangs pa chen po'i 'khor lo bri bar gsungs// man ngag ldan pas tshul bzhin bri bar bya// de la 'dir mdo las/ mi nad dang phyugs nad dang yams kyi nad dang*/ gnod pa dang 'tshe ba dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa thams cad dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen mo 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te rim gro cher mchod pa chen po byas la grong khyer chen po'i sgo'am/ grong ngam/ grol brdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so// gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir zlog ma chen mo 'di rim gro cher byas te btsugs na btsugs ma thag tu g.yul zhi bar 'gyur ro// zhes pa'i sgo nas 'khor lo bri bar gsungs pa ni yul khams bsrung bar bya ba dang*/ bsgrub bya bsrung bar bya ba gnyis las/ dang po yul khams bsrung bar bya ba ni/ dus bzang po yar ngo lta bu la gza' skar 'grub sbyor bzang po la mgo brtsams te/ 'khor lo 'dri mkhan gyi khrus byas gso sbyong blangs te kha zas gtsang ma zos/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas kha shar du bltas te/ ras sam shog bu la mu khyud rim pa bcu gnyis bskor bar bya ste/ de'i dbus su oṃ bri zhing*/ oṃ gyi klad kor thad nas

sam mdun nas kyang 'dug pas dpyad/ brtsams te yig mgo phyir bstan pas/ tad+ya thā/ a na le a na le/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bai ra bai ra/ badz+ra dha ri/ ban+dha ban+dha/ badz+ra pā ṇi bhan+dha phaṭa/ dpe gcig tu/ bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhes snang*/ srung ba'i 'khor lo 'di nyid bzhugs pa'i khang khyim dgon gnas yul phyogs thams cad dang mchod bstod 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum la nye bar 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs dang*/ nad rims mu ge dus min 'chi ba rgyal 'gong dam sri lha klu sde brgyad sogs kyi gnod pa/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs ngan gshom dug mtshon legs bsubs nyes sgrogs rmongs rengs byad kha rbod gtong bsad bskrad dbye mnan/ sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol/ zhes 'bri/ de'i phyi rim du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad byas pa'i shar gyi 'dab la/ na mo bha ga ba tī a n+ya s+ya na mu n+yai 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun nyer 'tshe'i phyogs kun las rgyal te mthu stobs mnga' thang rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ shar lho la/ na mo bha ga bān ta thā ga ta ku la s+ya 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i don kun 'grub cing dbang thang dpal 'byor rigs brgyud rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ lho la/ na mo bha ga bān+pad+mā ku la s+ya 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ lho nub la/ na mo bha ga bān badz+ra ku la s+ya 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i srog lus dbang thang rlung rta thams cad dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ nub la/ na mo bha ga bān+ma ṇi ku la s+ya 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i ji ltar smon pa'i don thams cad skad cig nyid la 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ nub byang la/ na mo bha ga bān+hasti ku la s+ya 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos srid kyi legs tshogs thams cad yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzad du gsol/

byang la/ na mo bha ga bān+ku mā ra ku la s+ya 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i thos bsam sgom gsum sogs dge legs kyi yon tan rnams rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ byang shar la/ na mo bha ga bān+nā gā dhi ku la s+ya 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i khang khyim 'dir srid pa gsum gyi dpal 'byor longs spyod 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes bri/ de'i phyi rim gyi mu khyud la/ tad+ya thā/ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ bhan+dha bhan+dha 'chang ba la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa oṃ ṛ ṣi ga ṇa pra shwasta sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ drūm̐ srung 'khor 'di nyid bzhugs pa'i yul phyogs khang khyim 'chang ba mi nor 'khor bcas pa la nad dang rims dang gdon bgegs kyi gnod pa dang kha smras kha mchu pha rol gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rig sngags sogs mi mthun nyer 'tshe phyogs thams cad bsrung du gsol bsrung du gsol/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes bri/ de'i phyi rim du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad du byas pa'i shar gyi rtsibs la/ dzam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ drūm̐ stam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ drūm̐ 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal te ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ 'di 'gre'o// shar lho'i rtsibs la/ ma hā bing+ya saṃ bhak+ṣa ṇa ka rī hūm̐ drūm̐ 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi 'dod pa'i rgud pa kun las rgyal te stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas par= lho la/ pa ra bing+yā saṃ bhāk+ṣa ṇa ka rī hūm̐ drūm̐ 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las= lho nub la/ sarba duṣ+ṭā nāṃ stam+bha na ka rī hūm̐ drūṃ 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi 'dod pa'i rgud pa kun las rgyal te stobs 'byor thang rgyas par= nub la/ sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa gra hā ṇāṃ bidh+waṃ sa na ka rī hūm̐ drūṃ 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las rgyal te ci bsam lhun gyis grub par=

nub byang la/ tsa tu rā shī tī nāṃ gra ha sa ha srā ṇāṃ bidh+waṃ sa na ka ri hūm̐ drūm̐ 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi 'dod pa'i rgud pa kun las rgyal te stobs dang mnga' thang rgyas par= byang la/ aṣ+ṭā biṃ sha tī nāṃ nak+ṣa trā ṇāṃ pra sā dha na ka rī hūm̐ drūm̐ 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs kun las rgyal te ci bsam lhun gyis grub par= byang shar la/ aṣ+ṭa nāṃ ma hā gra hā ṇāṃ bi dh+waṃ sa na ka ri hūm̐ drūm̐ 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi 'dod pa'i rgud pa kun las rgyal te stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bri/ rtsibs mchan brgyad la shar gyi g.yon nas brtsams te rim pa bzhin/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍī 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la gzhan gyi sbyor ba ngan pa byed pa thams cad bsrung du gsol// pad+ma s+yā bhi ni mit+ta wān 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la mtshon gyi gnod pa thams cad bsrung= ma hā dz+wa la yā 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad bsrung du= a n+ya s+yā mu n+yā 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la me dang chu'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsrung= was+t+ra shukla yā 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la 'ching ba dang gsod pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad bsrung du= badz+ra tuṇ+ḍen 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gnod pa thams cad bsrung du= tā ra ya 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la rmi lam dang mtshan ltas ngan pa thams cad bsrung du= dza ya s+ya badz+ra yā 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la dug gi gnod pa thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes sde tshan re re la g.yas skor du bri/ de'i phyi rim gyi mu khyud la/ oṃ in+d+ri ye/ oṃ ag+na ye/ oṃ ya ma ye/ oṃ nair ṛ ta ye/ oṃ wā ru ṇa ye/ oṃ bā ya be/ oṃ ku be ra ye/ oṃ ī shwā na ye/ oṃ ur+dhaṃ brah+ma ṇa ye/ oṃ sūr+ya bra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ oṃ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ oṃ a bho pṛ thi wī bh+yaḥ

oṃ a su re bh+yaḥ oṃ nā ge bh+yaḥ oṃ dhṛ ta rāṣ+ṭa ye/ oṃ bai rū ḍha ka ye/ oṃ bi rū bāk+ṣa ye/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye/ oṃ me gholka ye/ oṃ shi tāṃ sha be/ oṃ rak+tā k+ṣa aṃ ga ku mā ra ye/ oṃ shu kra ye/ oṃ pri haspa ta ye/ oṃ kriṣ+ṇā war+ṇa ye/ oṃ a mṛ ta pri yā ya/ oṃ sarba nak+ṣa tra/ oṃ rā hu la 'chang ba mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa 'jigs pa dang steng 'og gi gdon sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal zhing gzi brjid nus mthu mnga' thang longs spyod snyan grags tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa bri/ de'i phyi rim gyi mu khyud la/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṅghā ya/ na mo bud+dhaḥko ṭi sap+ta shrī shru saṃ gha sh+tsa saṃ hi tā ya/ na mo3rta te bh+yaḥ na ma shashro tā ban+naḥn mo nā gā mī/ na mo3 nā gā mi/ na mal+lo ke saṃ gats+tsha/ na mas+sa mā ban+ni bh+yaḥ na mo de ba s+ya ṛ ṣir+shā sa sid+dhi bh+yaḥ na mo bing+yā sid+dhi bh+ya/ na mo brah+ma ṇā ya/ na ma in+d+rā ya/ na mo bha byaṃ ru drastap+to bā reḥpa tiṃ tsa sa hā ya/ na mo bha byaṃ nā rā ya ṇā ya ma hā pañtsha mu dra na maskṛ te/ na mo bha byaṃ ma hā kā la na ga re bā tri kū ṭo bhai ra waḥka ṭa shīsmā sha ne muk+ti ka e ḍa kā saṃ bhā re ṇa na maskṛ te/ na mas+saṃ bud+dha bī ras+thi rā se na yu dha s+ya rā dza ne/ na mas+saṃ bud+dhā mi tā bhā ya/ na maḥsaṃ bud+dho3k+ṣo bh+yaḥ na maḥsaṃ bud+dho bhai ṣa dz+ya gu ra we/ na maḥsaṃ bud+dha s+sā la s+yen+d+raḥpuṣ+pa na saṃ pu ṣā ya/ na maḥsaṃ bud+dhā shākya mu na ye/ na maḥsaṃ bud+dho rat+na ke tu rā dza ne/ na mas+saṃ bud+dha yā bha dra ya/ na mas+saṃ bud+dha bai ro tsa nā ye/ na mas+saṃ bud+dho nai traḥpu ṣot+pa la gan+dha s+ya ke to rā dza n-i hi rak+ṣa dzñāp+ti/ zhes pa bri/ de'i phyi rol du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu byas pa'i shar stod kyi rtsibs/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha hūm̐ ka ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa byad gdon gyi gnod pa thams cad bsrung du gsol/

shar smad kyi rtsibs la/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha bi dza ya kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa mi mthun pa'i 'jigs pa kun las rgyal bar mdzad du gsol/ shar lho/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la dbyug gu drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gnod pa thams cad bsrung du gsol/ lhor/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha ya mān+ta ka kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la 'chi bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bsrung du gsol/ lho nub tu/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha ār+ya a tsa la kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la steng 'og gi gdon gyi gnod pa kun bsrung du gsol/ nub stod du/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha ha ya grī ba kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la rgyal po dang dam sri'i gnod pa thams cad bsrung du gsol/ nub smad du/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha ma hā ba la kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la dgra rkun gyi 'tshe ba thams cad bsrung du gsol/ nub byang du/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ḍī ṣa kro dha ṭak+ki rā dza kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la kha smras mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bsrung du gsol/ byang du/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha a mṛ ta kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa la grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad bsrung du gsol/ byang shar du/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha trai lokya kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams la gnod pa'i gdon thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes pa bri/ rtsibs mchan bcu la/ shar stod kyi g.yon nas rim bzhin/ hūm̐ ka re ṇa 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas la tshangs pa'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ bi dza ye na 'chang ba 'khor bcas la dri za'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ nī la daṇ+ḍa pā nā 'chang ba 'khor bcas la me lha'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/

ya mān+ta ke na 'chang ba 'khor bcas la gshin rje'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ a tsa la yā 'chang ba 'khor bcas la srin po'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ ha ya grī we ṇa 'chang ba 'khor bcas la chu lha'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ ma hā ba le na 'chang ba 'khor bcas las bdag gi gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ ṭāk+ki rā dze na 'chang ba 'khor bcas la rlung lha'i gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa le na 'chang ba 'khor bcas la gnod sbyin gyi gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ bi dza ye na 'chang ba 'khor bcas la dbang ldan gyi gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ zhes sde tshan re re la g.yas skor du bri/ de'i mu khyud phyi ma la yig mgo nang du bstan la/ 'di rnams bri/ oṃ a si tā a na lārka pa bhā s+phu ṭa bi kā si tā ta pa tre/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khā da khā da/ ha na ha na/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo ghā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha tā ya phaṭa/ ba ra dā ya phaṭa/ ba ra pra dā ya phaṭa/ pra t+yaṃ gi ri tā ya phaṭa/ a su ra bi drā ba ṇa ka rā ya phaṭa/ pa ra bi drā ba ṇa ka rā ya phaṭa/ sarba de be bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba nā ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a ru re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba mā ru te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ga ru ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba gan+dharbe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kin+na re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma ho ra ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba yak+ṣe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba rāk+ṣa se bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pri te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pi shā tse bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bhū te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kum+bhaṇ+ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pū ta ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ka ṭa pū ta ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba skan+de bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba un+mā de bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ts+tsha ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a pa smā re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba o stā ra ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba durlaṃ ghi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba duḥpre k+ṣi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba dz+wa re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kṛ t+yā karma ṇe kā khorde bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ki ra ṇe bai tā ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsits+tsha pre ṣa ka du shats+tsha rdi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba dur+bhuk+te bh+yaḥphaṭa/

sarba tīr+thi ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba shra ma ṇe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bing+yā dha re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ dza ya ka ra ma dhu ka re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ar+tha swa dha ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bing+yā tsa re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsa tur bh+yo bha gi nī bh+ya phaṭa/ badz+ra kau mā rī ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bing+yā ra dzhā+ai te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ma hā prat+yaṃ gi re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ badz+ra shrī kha lā ya pra t+yaṃ gi ra rā dzā ya phaṭa/ ma hā kā lā ya mā tṛ ga ṇa na maskṛ tā ye phaṭa/ biṣ+ṇā bī ye phaṭa/ brah+ma ṇī ye phaṭa/ ag+na ye phaṭa/ ma hā kā lī ye phaṭa/ kā la daṇ+ḍī ye phaṭa/ in+d+rī ye phaṭa/ rau drī ye phaṭa/ ku mā rī ye phaṭa/ bā rā hī ye phaṭa/ tsā muṇ+ḍī ye phaṭa/ rā trī ye phaṭa/ kā lā rā trī ye phaṭa/ ya ma daṇ+ḍī ye phaṭa/ ka pā lī ye phaṭa/ u dhi muk+ti sh+ma shā na bā si nī ye phaṭa/ 'chang ba 'khor dang bcas la gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa'i rigs sngags thams cad bsrung du gsol/ zhes pa bri/ de'i phyi rim gyi mu khyud la/ sarba gra he ṇa kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshan+daṃ mya si nā ki la ya/ saṃ tsa re ṇa kri to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ ḍā ka ḍā ki ni kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ ma hā pa shu pa ti nā kṛ to s+ya bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ nā rā ya ṇe na kri to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ ma hā kā lash+tsai ḍā kā sam+bha re ṇa kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ na da s+ya kā pa lī kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ dza ya kṛ taṃ tsa ma dhu ra kṛ taṃ tsa sarba ar+tha sid+dhi kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ tsa tur+bha gi nī kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ bhṛṅgi ri ti tsa pri ya ka ra ī shwa ra tsa ga ṇā pa ti tsa sa tu kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ shra ma ṇa nag+ne na kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ ar+ha te na kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ bi ta rā ga kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/

gu h+ya pa ti pā ṇi badz+re ṇa kṛ to bing+yā ts+tshin+da mya si nā kī la ya/ zhes pa bri/ de'i phyi rim gyi mu khyud la/ bha ga wān ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa to bhū ta s+ya ts+tsha tra si tā a pa rā dzi ta badz+ro ṣ+ṇī ṣaḥpra ti pā ri ma hā tī sa ha sra pā ṇi ma hā dh+rīkaḥshi ro ma hā dh+rīkaḥne tra ko ṭi sha ta sa ha sra ma hā dh+rīkaḥ a bhe ng+ye dz+wa la ṭi ka rī badz+ra pṛ thu ma hā tī tri bhū mi maṇ+ḍa la ma hā dh+rīkaḥ sarba satwā 'chang ba mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa dzñāp+ti rak+ṣa dzñāp+ti/ oṃ rā dza no bha yā tra/ tsau ra s+ya bha yā tra/ ag+ne ཿbha yā tra/ u+u da ka s+ya bha yā tra/ bi ṣa s+ya bha yā tra/ shas+t+ra s+ya bha yā tra/ pa rā nī ka bṛn+daṃ bha yā tra/ dur+bhi k+ṣa s+ya bha yā tra/ sha troḥbha yā tra/ ro ga s+ya bha yā tra/ a shi neḥbha yā tra/ a kā la mri t+yu bha yā tra/ dha ra ṇi kalpa s+ya bha yā tra/ ulkā pā da s+ya bha yā tra/ rā dza daṇ+ḍa s+ya bha yā tra/ de wa gra hā tra/ nā ga gra hā tra/ a su ra gra hā tra/ mā ru ta gra hā tra/ ga ru ḍa gra hā tra/ gan+dharba gra hā tra/ kin+na ra gra hā tra/ ma ho ra ga gra hā tra/ yak+ṣa gra hā tra/ rāk+ṣa s+ya gra hā tra/ pre ta s+ya gra hā tra/ bi shā tsa s+ya gra hā tra/ bhū ta sa mān+ta s+ya gra hā tra/ kum+bhaṇ+ḍa s+ya gra hā tra/ bū ta na s+ya gra hā tra/ ka ṭa pū ta na s+ya gra hā tra/ skan+da s+ya gra hā tra/ a pa smā ra gra hā tra/ un+mā da s+ya gra hā tra/ ts+tshā ya s+ya gra hā tra/ ostā ra ka s+ya gra hā tra/ re ba tī gra hā tra/ dzā ma ka s+ya gra hā tra/ sa ku ni gra hā tra/ mā tri nan+da nī ya gra hā tra/ sha mi ka s+ya gra hā tra/ gaṇ+ḍī san+ta pa gra hā tra pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ dz+wa ra e ka ti kāsh+tsa/ dwai tī ya kāsh+tsa/ trai tī ya kāsh+tsa/ tsa tur+thi kāsh+tsa/ sa bhā ti kāsh+tsa/ ni t+ya dz+wā rā rāsh+tsa/ bi ṣa ma dz+wa rāsh+tsa/ duṣ+ṭakla ma dz+wa rāsh+tsa/ bā ti kāsh+tsa/ bait+ti kāsh+tsā/ sh+lesmi kāsh+tsa/ sān+di pā ti kāḥpra t+yaṃ gi ra/

sarba dz+wa ra sh+tsa/ masta ka byā dhirtsa/ pā ra shwār+dha byā dhirtsa/ a ro tsa kaṃ tsa/ a k+ṣi byā dhirtsa/ nā sā byā dhirtsa/ mu khaṃ byā dhirtsa/ kaṇ+ṭha hri da byā dhirtsa/ ba la gra ha byā dhirtsa/ kar+ṇa byā dhirtsa/ dan+ta byā dhirtsa/ mā da byā dhirtsa/ pā ra shwa byā dhirtsa/ pṛṣ+ṭha byā dhirtsa/ u da ra byā dhirtsa/ ka ṭi byā dhirtsa/ bāste yaṃ byā dhirtsa/ dzagha naṃ byā dhirtsa/ dzaṃ ghā byā dhirtsa/ hastaṃ byā dhirtsa/ pā daṃ byā dhirtsa/ aṅga byā dhirtsa/ pra t+yaṅga byā dhirtsa/ pa rā pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ te dzo haṃ rash+tsa/ oṃ dzo ha rash+tsa/ oṃ da naṃ gar+bhā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ ru dhi raṃ pā naṃ tsa/ o da naṃ ba pā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ mān+sā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ me dā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ madz+dza dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ dzā tā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ dzī bi tā hā rash+tsa/ o da naṃ bān+dā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ pre shā ts+ya ྄dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ ma trā pā naṃ tsa/ o da naṃ s+yan+du ni kā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ ba she ṣa dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ khe ṭā pā naṃ tsa/ o da naṃ siṃ hā ṇa kā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ pū yaṃ dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ pu rī ṣa dza k+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ mā l+ya dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ gan+dha dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ dhū pā dza k+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ puṣ+pā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ pha lā dzak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ sha s+ya tsak+ṣaṃ tsa/ o da naṃ ho tra dzak+ṣaṃ pa rā pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ dz+wa rash+tsa/ da ṭ+ṭūṃ tsa/ ī ti tsa/ ki ṭi bhaṃ tsa/ kuṣ+ṭhaṃ tsa/ ba ṭai kaṃ tsa/ lū taṃ tsa/ be sarbañtsa/ bā mā tsa/ lo ha liṅga sh+tsa/ sho ṣaṃ tsa/ trā saṃ tsa/ ga raṃ tsa/ bi ṣa yo gaṃ tsa/ kā khorde tsa/ ag+ni rtsa/ u da kaṃ tsa/ mā raṃ tsa/ sha truṃ tsa/ ni kā raṃ tsa/ a kā la mṛ t+yush+tsa/ bh+ra ma ra h+yam+pa kaṃ tsa/ trai lā ṭa kaṃ tsa/ pri ṣatsa kaṃ tsa/ sarbaṃ tsa/ na ku laṃ tsa/ sidhaṃ tsa/ byā gh+rā tsa/ ṛ k+ṣaṃ tsa/ ta rak+ṣu tsa/ pṛ kaṃ tsa/ mā ka raṃ tsa/ bhṛṅge bā n+ya s+ya dzi ba hā rāḥpra t+yaṃ gi ra/ bha ga wān ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣā to bhā ta s+ya ts+tsha tra sitā a pa rā dzi ta badz+ro ṣ+ṇī ṣaḥpra ti bā ri ma hā tī sa ha sra pā ṇi ma hā dhṛkaḥ

shi ro ma hā dhikaḥ ko ṭi sha taṃ sa hā sre ne tra ma hā dh+rikaḥ a bhe d+ye dz+wa la ṭi ka rī badz+ra pri thu ma hā tī tri bhū mi maṇ+ḍal dh+ṝka kā rā ma hā ne na dwād shā yo dza na s+yot+paṃ gārbā gi sarba gra hash+tsa pa rā kṛdwi d+yā sarba kā ra ṇā pra t+yaṃ gi ra dzñā p+tīḥ 'chang ba la pha rol pos mthu gtad ngan sngags kyi sbyor ba bshoms pa thams cad srung du gsol/ zhes pa bri/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la yig mgo nang du bstan la/ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣānata thā ga to h+ya ba data te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ bde gshegs thugs rjes gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed tshar bcad nas// bde legs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// bde mchog gdugs kar can gyi bkra shis shog /'dod pa lan cig phyir 'ong dang*// gang dag phyir mi 'ong ba dang*// rgyun zhugs de dag zhugs pa dang*// 'bras bur gnas pas phye ba ste// 'phags pa'i gang zag brgyad rnams kyi// bkra shis dam pa'i bkra shis shog /gshin rje mthar byed shes mthar byed// pad+ma mthar byed bgegs mthar byed// mi g.yo 'dod rgyal dbyug sngon can// stobs chen gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur// hūm̐ mdzad la sogs khro bo yi// rgyal po rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /yi dam lha yi bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog /dbang phyug nor lha rnams kyi bkra shis shog /mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral don rtogs thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /dza ya dza ya su dza yaḥ zhes bri'o// de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la phyogs mtshams brgyad du rdo rje re re bri/ de dag gi phyi rol du me ri bri bar bya'o// zhes pa 'di yul 'khor srung ba'i tsakra'o//

//gnyis pa bsgrub bya srung ba'i tsakra la/ dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad dor la/ mthu zlog pa sogs yin na/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la/ khro bcu'i sngags kha phyir bstan nas bri zhing srung ba kha nang bstan du bri/ de'i phyi rol mu khyud la/ tad+ya thā/ sarba ta thā ga to/ oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ bhan+dha sogs gong bzhin bri/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la rdo rwa dang rten 'brel snying po bri/ de'i phyi me ris bskor la/ rab tu gnas pa gzhung bzhin byas la 'dogs par bshad/ ༈ rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga ni/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel na mchog yin pas rgyal mtshan legs par 'du byas la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus sam shar phyogs su btsugs/ sgrub mchod re re bzhin ye shes pa rnams bstims la brtan bzhugs dang*/ shis pa brjod pa rnams tshar ci mang du byas la/ de nas gtor ma btang ba'i rjes la rgyal mtshan 'dzugs par bshad/ sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel na pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su gtso mo bskyed/ de'i phyi rol du mchod gtor bshams la/ rgyal mtshan sbyang ba dang*/ khrus gsol ba dang*/ dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug dbang bskur/ rgyas gdab/ mchod bstod/ lha mo rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su bsgrub bya 'khor bcas chud par bsam zhing*/ brtan bzhugs bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rgyas par brjod la/ rgyal mtshan dkar po'am shing gtsang ma la gdugs legs par bzos pa'i dbus su tsakra gzhug tog la ring bsrel byin rlabs can gzhug pa'am/ gtso mo'i sku gzugs gzungs sngags tshang ba yang gzhug par bshad/ de lta bu dgu'am/ lnga'am/ gcig la sogs pa gang yang rung ba byas la/ legs ldan mched gsum dang phyogs skyong rgyal chen rnams la gtor ma btang ste/ bdag nyid gtso mo'i nga rgyal gyis/ hūm̐ sngon gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs ni// nag po chen pos 'jig pa'i tshe// bde gshegs sprul sku nyid kyis ni// gtsug tor gdugs dkar byin rlabs kyis// nag po chen po mnyes byas nas// gdugs dkar dam la btags nas ni// grong khyer sum brtsegs brtan par byas// sum brtsegs mi rnams bar chad bzlog

/de ltar sgrub mchog bdag gis kyang*// gtsug tor gdugs dkar dam can la// mchod dang gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi// mchod gtor dam pa 'di bzhes la// grong khyer chen po sum brtsegs bzhin// grong khyer 'di yang brtan par mdzod// sum brtsegs pa yi mi bzhin du// grong khyer 'di na gnas pa yi// gzhug dang mi gzhug thams cad kyi// mi mthun bar chad bzlog tu gsol// gzhan gyis bsgrubs pa'i rig sngags zlog /gzhan gyis rbad pa'i rigs sngags bzlog /rgyal mtshan 'di yi byin rlabs kyis// shar phyogs cha 'di bsrung du gsol// shar gyi gdon tshogs phyir zlog cig /'byor dang bkra shis tshur stsol cig /sngags rnams tshar gcig tshang bar brjod// shar phyogs su gzugs shing*/ de bzhin du phyogs mtshams su tshig 'don pa bsgyur la bya'o// slar 'khor ba dang dbus su gzugs shing mchod bstod bya'o// gal te rgyal mtshan lnga las med na phyogs bzhi dang dbus su gzugs/ gcig las med na phyogs rnams su gtor ma btang*/ rgyal mtshan khyed la rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i tshig rnams so sor brjod de/ rgyal mtshan dbus su gzugs par bya zhing*/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa'i tshigs bcad dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya chen po dang*/ phyogs skyong rgyal chen bzhi la bka' bsgo bya'o// tshul 'di ni tsan+d+ra go mīs gsungs pa'i rgya gzhung dang*/ slob dpon kha che dkar po'i yig cha dang*/ 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa rin po che'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga nas legs pa'i cha rnams btus te/ 'gro la phan pa'i ched du sngags 'chang shākya dpal gyis mkhas grub rim par byon pa'i gdan sa chen po zhwa lu ri phug tu sbyar ba'o// 'khor lo la yi ge'i tshag shad spangs nas bar mtshams med par bri ba lag len yin no// 'di'i phan yon ni/ sus de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i rigs sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di/

ras sam shing shun la bris te/ lus sam mgul du btags na de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ dug gis mi tshugs/ mes mi tshugs/ chus mi tshugs/ dbyig dug gis mi tshugs/ dug sbyar mas mi tshugs/ byad kyis mi tshugs/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur/ gdon bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur ro// tshe dang bsod nams dang stobs kyang rab tu rnyed do// shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes sogs phan yon rgyas pa gzhung du blta'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru uṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa trā yai/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo 'di la gsum/ gang las gsungs pa'i khungs smos/ lag tu blang ba'i thabs bshad/ de ltar bgyi ba'i phan yon bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la gsum/ bri ba/ sgrub pa/ las la sbyar ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ spyir bshad pa dang*/ bye brag tu dbye ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mi'i lugs dang*/ slob dpon shū rāṅga warma'i lugs so// phyi ma la gsum/ bri ba'i gzhi/ 'bri tshul/ byug rdzas so// 'bri tshul la gsum/ thig btab ste mu khyud bskor tshul/ yi ge 'god tshul/ tshon 'gyed tshul lo// dang po ni/ dbus sor gsum gyis zlum por bskor ba la mu khyud nyis rim/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud gcig byas pa la pad+ma 'dab brgyad shun pa dang bcas pa/ de'i phyi rol sor gcig pa'i mu khyud zlum po/ de'i phyi rol sor gsum gyi mu khyud zlum por bskor ba la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dbyibs bye'u phrug kha bslangs pa lta bu/ de'i phyi rol sor gnyis pa'i mu khyud zlum po/ de'i phyi rol sor gsum pa'i mu khyud zlum por bskor ba la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa shar nub gnyis kyi thad drang por 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar khel ba'i shar du gnyis/ nub tu gnyis/ phyogs gzhan dang mtshams su re re te bcu'o// de'i phyi rol sor phyed gsum pa'i mu khyud zlum po/

de'i phyi rol sor gnyis pa'i mu khyud zlum po/ de'i phyi rol sor bzhi pa'i mu khyud zlum po/ de'i phyi rol du sor phyed gnyis pa'i mu khyud zlum po nyis rim/ de'i phyi rol sor gsum tsam gyi tshod la re khā med pa'i me ri zlum skor ro// gnyis pa yi ge 'god pa'i tshul ni/ lte bar oṃ/ de'i mthar mu khyud la/ oṃ dang mjug sprad pa'i tshul gyis mdun nas brtsams te yig mgo phyir bstan pa g.yas skor du/ tad+ya thā nas/ hūm̐ drūṃ bhan+dha phaṭa spel tshig bcas/ mu khyud dang po la gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang gdung bdun la phyag 'tshal spel tshig dang bcas 'dab brgyad so sor dgod/ gnyis pa la/ tad+ya thā/ sarba ta thā ga to oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ sogs spel tshig bcas gsum par rtsibs brgyad la/ dzam+bha na ka rī sogs spel tshig bcas dang*/ shar gyi g.yon nas bzung rtsibs mchan brgyad la gtum chen ma sogs brgyad kyi mtshan spel tshig bcas/ bzhi par/ oṃ in+d+ra ye nas/ oṃ rā hu la zhes pa'i bar dang spel tshig bcas/ lnga par sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo nas/ ut+pa la'i dri'i tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo bar dang spel tshig bcas/ drug par shar ngos g.yon zur gyi rtsibs nas brtsams te/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa kro dha hūm̐ ka ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa nas/ trai lo kya zhes pa'i bar gyi khro bo bcu'i sngags so sor spel tshig bcas dang*/ rtsibs mchan bcu la/ khro bo hūm̐ ka ras tshangs pa'i gdon dang gnod pa thams cad rak+ṣa/ zhes pa lta bu spel tshig bcas/ bdun par yig mgo nang du bstan la shar nas brtsams te g.yon skor du/ oṃ a si tā a na lārka nas/ sh+ma sha na wā si nī ye phaṭa dang zlog pa'i spel tshig brgyad par yig mgo nang bstan du/ gdon thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do sogs nas/ 'phags pa lag na rdo rjes byas pa'i rigs sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo dang spel tshig bcas/

dgu par/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas/ gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol dang spel tshig bcas/ bcu par phyogs mtshams brgyad rdo rje 'phred du bzhag pa'i rdo rwa dang*/ shar dang byang shar gyi rdo rje'i bar du rten snying dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa zhes bri bas mtshon dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ rgyal bar brjod pa'i tshigs bcas yig mgo nang bstan g.yon skor du bri/ de'i phyi rol bcu gcig par me ri 'bar ba g.yas skor du bri'o// gsum pa tshon dgye tshul ni/ lte ba mu khyud nyis rim dmar nag la/ de nas rim gyis dmar nag dmar skya/ ser po bcas mdangs nang du bsdus/ mu khyud dang po'i pad 'dab brgyad 'dab ma re re nas mdangs gong ltar la/ pad shun rnams ser por bya/ gnyis pa dmar ser 'dres ma/ gsum pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad dkar po la rtsibs mtha' rnams mthing ga phra mos ri mo byed/ rtsibs mchan rnams dmar ser/ bzhi par rim bzhin mthing nag sngon po/ sngo skya'i mdangs/ lnga pa lte ba dang 'dra/ drug pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs bcu sngo skya/ mchan rnams ser po/ bdun pa mdangs kha phyir bstan ma gtogs lte ba dang 'dra/ brgyad pa la mdangs kha phyir bstan gyis li khri/ ser po/ ser skya/ dkar po/ dgu pa la mdangs kha phyir bstan pa'i spang nag spang skya/ spang*/ bcu pa'i rdo rje rnams ser po dang bar rnams dmar po/ bcu gcig pa'i me ri rtse nas rim bzhin dmar nag dmar/ dmar ser/ ser po rnams mdangs kha nang du bsdus la mdzes par bya/ de ni grong khyer srung ba'i 'khor lo chen po ji lta ba'i tshul yin la/ zhar la bsgrub bya srung ba'i 'khor lo bsdus pa bri tshul kyang shes par 'dod na gzhan du btsal lo// gsum pa ni/ spyi tsam du/ gur gum sogs dri bzang po dang*/ bye brag tu so sor rdzas byug tshul gyi yi ge zur du gsal/ gnyis pa sgrub pa la sbyor dngos/

rjes so// sbyor ba sgrub mchod du 'brel ba'am/ 'di nyid rkyang par sgrub tshul gnyis/ dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun gyi srung 'khor la sbyong ba dang khrus gsol bya/ de nas bskyed bzlas gsol 'debs zhal bsgyur brtan bzhugs shis brjod bcas so// rjes la lag len ltar bltabs/ tshon skud kyis dam du bcings/ bsrung bya'am/ yul gyi bdag po'i khams dang bstun pa'i dar ras kyis dril/ gsum pa las sbyor la/ yul khams srung ba rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga dang*/ bsgrub bya srung ba 'khor lo gdags pa'i cho ga'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi 'khor lo 'bri tshul gzungs rang las dmigs kyis ma gsal yang*/ spyir sngags 'chang ba'i phan yon rgya cher gsungs la/ 'phags bod du grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis bkral ba'i lugs srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig mchis kyang*/ deng dus thams cad kyis lag tu blang bya ni dpal gsang ba'i bdag po dang*/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo sogs lhag pa'i lha du mas rjes su bzung ba'i snye mdo ba bla chen shākya dpal gyis mdzad pa nyid gzhir bzhag ste 'bri ba yin na'ang*/ yig cha der rdzas dang rab gnas bya tshul sogs gsal bar ma bshad pas the tshom gyi phyogs la 'phyang ba dag dbugs 'byin pa'i slad du 'di skad ces gdams so// de'ang slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis mdzad pa'i gzhung las/ de la rang ngam gzhan srung bar 'dod pas gro ga'am/ ras sam/ shing shun la gur gum gyis rim pa bzhir bskor te/ zhes sogs gsungs pas spyi tsam du gur gum gyis bri ba'am/ snag tsha la gur gum bsre ba'am/ gur gum gyis byugs pa gang rung gis khyab la/ dmigs bsal yig cha 'ga' zhig las rdzas rgyas par bshad pa ltar na/ dbus su lte bar oṃ sogs la bzang drug dang dar sna bzhag de rgyab pad 'dab brgyad ser po byas la rin po che sna lnga byug de rgyab mu khyud la tsan+dan phye ma byug

de rgyab rtsibs brgyad ljang gu la gur gum/ spos dkar/ a ga ru nag po/ nā ga ge sar te dri zhim bzhi dang*/ sman sna gang 'byor ram/ 'bras bu gsum byug rtsibs mchan brgyad mthing gar byas pa las sna gang 'dzom byug de rgyab mu khyud gnyis pa tsan+dan dkar po byug de rgyab rtsibs bcu la rang sngags bgrangs pa'i nyungs dkar gyi phye ma byug rtsibs mchan la gsung rab tshig pa'i thal ba byug de rgyab mu khyud la sngags pa nus pa can gyi phur pa'i dbal gyi lcags phye dang*/ bya rgod kyi spu byug de rgyab mu khyud dmar po byas la rdo khab len byug de rgyab mu khyud che ba mthing ga byas la khro phye dang thog phye shing sna gang 'dzom byug de rgyab mu khyud ser po byas la gur gum byug rten 'brel snying po dang me ri dmar por byas la sin+dhū ra byug ces 'byung ba ltar bya'o// de nas rab gnas ji ltar bya ba ni/ slob dpon tsan+d+ras/ de ltar bris pa de maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhag nas/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par byas te/ 'khor lo'i dbus kyi yi ge las 'phags ma gdugs dkar mo can 'khor bcas bskyed par bya'o// de nas mdun du gzhal yas khang bsams te/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan drangs mchod pa byas te gzungs nas 'byung bas gsol ba btab la/ bzlas pa brgya'am/ stong ngam/ ci tsam 'tshams par bya'o// de nas 'khor lo yang mchod cing*/ tshangs pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ nye dbang dang*/ legs ldan la sogs pa la gtor ma phul te/ gsol ba btab nas zhes 'byung ba'i don/ gnas gtsang mar stegs kyi khar maṇ+ḍal che ba zhig bzhag de'i steng du 'khor lo bkram/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ nye logs su lha gtor dang*/ cha gsum dang*/ legs ldan mched gsum gyi gtor ma bcas bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar gdugs dkar zhal phyag yongs rdzogs sam/ zhal gsum phyag drug dang*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sogs gang rung bya/

de nas 'khor lo la sbyang khrus sngon du 'gro bas bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las me phung dang rdo rje'i rwa ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du chud pa'i ji skad bshad pa ltar mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo bris pa bskyed la/ de'i dbus kyi oṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ gdugs dkar 'khor bcas bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ de'i steng gi nam mkhar bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed la/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bzhugs su gsol/ mchod bstod gtor ma phul/ gzungs nas 'byung bas gsol ba btab la/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams ji tsam nus pa bzla/ de nas 'khor lo'i lha la yang mchod cing bstod la/ gtor ma cha gsum dang*/ legs ldan mched gsum gyi gtor ma bsngo zhing phrin las bcol/ slar yang nam mkha'i lha la mchod bstod dang gsol ba btab pas/ dngos grub stsol ba'i slad du dgyes bzhin 'od du zhu nas bris pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lha mo gtso 'khor la thim/ thugs rje'i 'od zer kun tu khyab pas sngags kyi yig 'bru mthu dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs shing yongs su gyur pa las sa bon gyi rnam par bsams la/ brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod kyi me tog 'thor/ de nas tshul bzhin bltabs la tshon skud sna lngas dkris te rin po che la sogs pa gwa'ur bcug go /ji ltar gdags pa'i tshul ni/ tsan+d+ras/ rang ngam gzhan skyes pa'am bud med kyis phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su 'gro bar byas nas/ yungs kar dang bcas lus sam mgul du btags na mes mi tshugs pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan no// zhes gsungs pas/ bsgrub bya de la sbyong khrus sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun mkhar gdugs dkar gtso 'khor sogs skyabs yul gsal gdab pa'i dmigs pa phog nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ skyabs 'gro'i tshig rjes zlos byar gzhug cing gsol ba thob ces bsgos la/ de dang slob dpon lhan cig pas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la sngags kyis btab pa'i yungs kar gyi thum po dang bcas gdags/

bka' bsgo dang shis brjod rgyas par byas la/ me tog gi char dbab par bya'o// gal te dbang dang 'brel na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur la/ rjes gnang dang 'brel bar byed na'ang rung bas/ rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub 'phral sbyang khrus sogs byas la gdags/ de bzhin byad 'grol sogs dang sbrel tshul kyang rig pa'i 'phrul zhes par bya'o// rgyal mtshan 'dzugs na yul khams srung ba'i tsakra nyid snye mdo ba'am/ mkhas pa dzñā na sogs kyi yig cha ltar 'dzugs so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /de ltar snye mdo ba'i gzhung dang*/ rje bla ma'i gsal byed le tshan dang bcas pas khog phub spyir bstan nas/ bye brag las la sbyor ba'i lag len dmigs bsal du bshad pa la/ yul khams dang bsgrub bya srung ba thun mong du bkod pa'i 'khor lo bri ba dang*/ rdzas byugs pa legs par grub pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo chen mo nyid bsgrub cing rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga la gsum/ sbyor dngos rjes so// dang po gnas gtsang mar stegs kyi khar maṇ+ḍal che ba zhig bzhag de'i steng du sngar bris pa'i 'khor lo zhal rang la phyogs par bkram/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ mdun du lha gtor dang*/ nye logs su cha gsum dang*/ legs ldan mched gsum gyi gtor ma bcas bum pa bcud ldan/ 'thor nas/ sbyong chas/ rdor dril/ sngon gtor dkar dmar gnyis bcas tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma chab kyis bran/ oṃ/ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku// gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che// gtum mo chen mo stobs chen mo// 'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che// dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo// 'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mo// 'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can// rgyal ba'i rdo rje'i phreng zhes grags// pad+ma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje'i mtshan// gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can// rdo rje khar rnams 'joms pa mo// zhi ba'i lha rnams kyis mchod ma// gzugs zhi gzi brjid chen mo can// 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo// rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan dang*// rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin ma// lag na rdo rje rig gser phreng*// le brgan rtsi dang rin chen ma// snang mdzad rdo rje'i gtsug tor grags// rnam par bsgyings ma'i rdo rje dang*// gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma// rdo rje'i 'gros dang dkar mo dang*// pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od ma// sangs rgyas dpal dang de bzhin spyan// rdo rje nyi ma'i 'od dang ni// de bzhin zla ba rdo rje 'dzin// phyag rgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod nas phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis gtor ma dkar gtor dmar gtor gnyis bsang sbyang*/

oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥs man+ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ spos bzung thal mo sbyar la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa rnams la= rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la= lan gcig phyir 'ong ba rnams la= phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la= 'jig rten na yang dag par song ba rnams la= yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la= lha'i drang srong dmod pa 'dor ba dang phan 'dogs nus pa rnams la= rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams la= tshangs pa la= dbang po la= legs ldan drag po dka' thub zlog pa'i bdag po dang ldan pa rnams la= legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa la= legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa dur khrod na gnas pa mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa la= bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la= pad+ma'i gdung la= rdo rje'i gdung la= nor bu'i gdung la= glang po'i gdung la= gzhon nu'i gdung la= klu'i gdung la= bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la= bcom ldan 'das sogs sbyar te/ sangs rgyas 'od dpag med la= sangs mi 'khrugs pa la= sangs rgyas sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la= sangs rgyas sā la'i dbang po'i me tog kun tu rgyas pa la= sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la= sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi rgyal po la= sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po la= sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la= sangs rgyas spyan rgyas pa ut+pa la'i bsung gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba phyir zlog ma chen mo 'dis 'byung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod pa/

gzhan gyi rigs sngags gcod pa/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba las zlog pa/ sems can bcings pa thams cad las grol ba/ sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad zlog pa/ gdon brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jig par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa/ gza' chen po brgyad 'jigs par byed pa/ dgra thams cad zlog pa/ ma rungs pa dang sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ dug dang mtshon dang me dang chu las sgrol ba ste/ rig sngags kyi sbyor ba 'di sbyar bar bya'o// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la rig sngags 'grub par gyur cig swā hā/ 'byung po'i tshogs gang dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang*/ nam mkha' la rgyu ba= chu la rgyu ba= lha= klu= lha ma yin= rlung lha= nam mkha' lding= dri za= mi'am ci= lto 'phye chen po= gnod sbyin= srin po= yi dwags= sha za= grul bum= srul po= lus srul po= skem byed= smyo byed= grib gnon= rjed byed= gnon po rnams bdag la nyon cig 'byung po'i tshogs gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ mdangs 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ zas su mngal za ba= zas su khrag 'thung ba= zas su zhag za ba= las su sha za ba= zas su rkang= zas su btsas pa= srog 'phrog pa= zas su gtor ma= zas su phreng ba za= de bzhin du sbyar te/ dri za ba= bdug pa= me tog= 'bras bu= lo tog= sbyin sreg= rnag= phyi sa= gcin 'thung ba= lhag ma= mchil ma 'thung ba= snabs= ngar snabs= mi gtsang ba= skyugs pa= stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung= sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa= sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa= drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa= gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bdag la nyon cig rig sngags chen mo 'di bsgrub par bya'o// spos dang me tog dang bdug pa dang gtor ma yang sbyin no// gtor ma dang mchod pa 'dis mgu bar gyis la= bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/

sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ gzi brjid 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad phyir dengs shig oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ rol mo drag po bya/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug de nas mtshams bcad par bya'o// bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen mo'i bkas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa= drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa= lha'i gdon rnams dang*/ klu'i= lha ma yin gyi= rlung lha'i= nam mkha' lding gi= dri za'i= mi'am ci'i= lto 'phye chen po'i= gnod sbyin gyi= srin po'i= yi dwags kyi= sha za'i= skem byed kyi= smyo byed kyi= grib gnon gyi= rjed byed kyi= gnon po'i= mkha' 'gro ma'i= nam gru'i= gshin rje'i= bya'i= ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i= kun tu 'gro ba'i= tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang*/ rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang*/ nyin gnyis pa= nyin gsum pa= nyin bzhi pa= nyin bdun pa= rtag pa'i rims dang*/ rims mi zad pa dang*/ rims ldang dub rnams dang= rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las= bad kan las= 'dus pa las= rims nad thams cad dang*/ klad pa na ba dang*/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang*/ yi ga 'chus pa dang*/ mig nad dang*/ kha= mgul= snying= lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang*/ rna ba= so= snying= rtsibs logs= rgyab= lto ba= rked pa= chu so= brla= rje ngar= lag pa= rkang pa= yan lag= nying lag= rims nad dang= shu ba dang*/ g.yan pa dang*/ 'brum bu dang*/ mdze dang*/ phol mig dang*/ gag lhog dang*/ bas bldags dang*/ me dbal dang*/ lhog pa dang*/ skem pa dang*/ skrag pa dang*/ dbyig dug dang*/ dug sbyar ma dang*/ byad dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ mi ngas dang*/ dgra dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa de dag thams cad kyi rigs sngags bcing bar bgyi'o// gzi brjid 'phrog par bgyi'o// gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad bcing bar bgyi'o// gdon thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o// gnod pa thams cad las bsrung bar bgyi'o// gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mos 'di'i dpag tshad bcu gnyis tshun chad du gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar bgyi'o// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bsrung du gsol/

lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig swā hā/ oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ bhan+dhā bhan+dhā badz+ra ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsang ba nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod bstod sogs gsol gdab bar dang*/ de nas bum pa bsgrubs ste lha 'od du zhu lhag chad bskang ba'i bar byad 'grol bum chog ltar la/ sngags 'di nyid kyi dkyus nas 'byung ba bzhin bzla/ gnyis pa la/ sbyong chas mdun du bshams pa chus bran te rten la bskor ba dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te sogs nas/ drag po'i sbyong ba'i bar byad 'grol bzhin la/ sbyin bdag ces pa'i tshab tu bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la rab tu gnas par byed pa la zhes bsgyur/ de nas rten la khrus gsol ba'ang byad 'grol bzhin byas mthar/ mdun gyi 'khor lo bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las srung ba'i 'khor lo me dpung dang rdo rje'i rwa ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du chud pa'i mu khyud zlum po rim pa bzhi/ de'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ de'i nang du mu khyud zlum po nyis rim/ de'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ de'i nang du mu khyud zlum po/ de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dang bcas pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa/ de'i dbus kyi oṃ yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can nas tshar gcod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'o yi bar byad 'grol bum chog bzhin dang*/ de'i phyi rol du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la gzhan gyis mi thub ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang bsdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ 'dab ma gzhan bdun la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung*/ pad+ma'i gdung*/ rdo rje'i gdung*/ nor bu'i gdung*/ glang po'i gdung*/ gzhon nu'i gdung*/ klu'i gdung ste gdung bdun/ mu khyud kyi phyi rol tu 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i shar gyi g.yon nas brtsams te rtsibs mchan rnams su gtum chen ma dkar mo/

lhor 'bar chen ma ser mo/ nub tu gos dkar mo dmar mo/ byang du sgrol ma ljang gu/ byang shar du rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma sngon mo/ shar lhor pad+ma'i mngon mtshan ma ser mo/ lho nub tu gzhan gyis mi thub ma dmar mo/ nub byang du rdo rje'i mchu can ma ljang gu/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la brgya byin ser po/ me lha dmar po/ gshin rje nag po/ srin po nag po/ chu lha dkar po/ rlung lha dud ka ku be ra ser po/ dbang ldan dkar po/ tshangs pa ser po/ sa'i lha mo ser mo ste phyogs skyong ba bcu/ yul 'khor srung ljang gu/ 'phags skyes po sngon po/ mig mi bzang dmar po/ rnam thos sras ser po ste rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ gza' nyi ma dmar po/ zla ba dkar po/ mig dmar dmar po/ lhag pa ljang gu/ phur bu ser po/ pa sangs dkar po/ spen pa nag po/ sgra gcan dmar po/ ke tu skya bsangs te gza' chen po dgu/ de'i phyi rol gyi mu khyud la sangs rgyas dang*/ chos dang*/ dge 'dun dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa/ rgyun du zhugs pa/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba/ phyir mi 'ong ba/ yang dag par song ba/ yang dag par zhugs pa/ lha'i drang srong dang*/ rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ dbang po dang*/ legs ldan nag po chen po mched gsum/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po/ 'od dpag med/ mi 'khrugs pa/ sman gyi bla baiḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po/ sā la'i dbang po'i me tog kun tu rgyas pa/ shākya thub pa/ rin po che tog gi rgyal po/ kun tu bzang po/ rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan rgyas pa ut+pa la'i bsung gi tog gi rgyal po ste bde bar gshegs pa bcu/ de'i phyi rol gyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bcu pa'i shar stod kyi rtsibs la khro bo hūm̐ ka ra/ shar smad kyi rtsibs la rnam par rgyal ba/

shar lhor dbyug sngon can/ lhor gshin rje'i gshed/ lho nub tu mi g.yo ba/ nub stod du rta mgrin/ nub smad du stobs po che/ nub byang du 'dod pa'i rgyal po/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ byang shar du khams gsum rnam rgyal rnams gnas pa ste thams cad kyang rang rang gi zhal phyag dang rgyan cha lugs bzhon pa la sogs yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ de rnams kyi dpral par oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkhar bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs khor yug dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar po'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i gdan/ de'i phyi rol du'ang pad nyi la sogs pa lha so so'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros bcom ldan 'das ma la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas rigs su// nad kyi bskal pas zhig la khad// bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis// srung zhing skyob pa'i las mdzad nas// ma mo thams cad dbang du bsdus// de yi spyi bo'i gtsug tu nub// stong gsum thams cad spyan gyis gzigs// de la ming dang mtshan gsol ba// gtsug tor nor bu'i gdugs dkar mo// sngon tshe phrin las mdzad pa ltar// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs// chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs su gsol// bskul lo sems can don la bskul// sems can don la bskul gyis gshegs// rgyal dang chom kun me dang chu// dug mtshon pha rol dmag dpung dang*// mu ge dgra dang lce 'bab 'jigs// thams cad bzlog phyir gshegs su gsol// gzhan gyis mi thub gtum chen ma// 'bar ba chen mo gos dkar can// sgrol ma rgyal ba'i rdo rje dang*// pad+ma'i mngon mtshan mi thub ma// rdo rje mchu can ma dang bcas// 'khor lo'i lha tshogs thams cad kyang*// 'byung ba'i gdon rnams tshar bcad phyir// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// gzhan yang gdung bdun bde gshegs bcu// sangs rgyas byang sems legs ldan gsum// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// srung ma'i tshogs dang lha klu rnams// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ sh+ya ho/

ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brang nas bde bar gshegs pa'i rten la rab tu gnas par byed pa la mi mthun par byed pa'i gdon gshegs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir mi gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces a na le dang sum+bha bzla/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ aṃ ku sha dzaḥ pā sha hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa baṃ/ ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ lha rnams gzhal yas khang du byon par bsam/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag 'bul na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya staṃ/ ci 'dod dngos grub ma thob bar// phrin las ma lus sgrub 'tshal gyi// gzhal yas pho brang dam pa 'dir// thugs rjes brtser dgongs brtan par bzhugs// oṃ badz+ra sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ de yang pho brang gi dbus kyi lte bar pad zla'i gdan la gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes pa nas/ bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du gzhan gyis mi thub ma nas/ gdung bdun/ de'i phyi rol du pad zla'i gdan la shar du gtum chen ma nas/ mchu can ljang gu/ de'i phyi rol tu brgya byin nas/ gza' chen po dgu/ de'i phyi rol tu sangs rgyas nas/ bde bar gshegs pa bcu/ de'i phyi rol tu 'khor lo rtsibs bcur pad nyi'i gdan la shar stod du khro bo hūm̐ ka ra/ shar smad du rnam par rgyal ba nas/ zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ de nas mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs te/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can nyon mongs bag chag sbyong slad du// sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// khams gsum gnas pa'i bag chags dag gyur cig /dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed cing*// kha dog dbyibs legs mdzes pa'i me tog ni// nam mkha' gang bar sems gyis mngon sprul te// gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig

/tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te// sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pas// rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i// shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di// sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du// phyogs bcu kun tu snang bas khyab gyur cig /stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung 'gyur zhing*// spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i chu// ye shes mkha' la bdud rtsi'i char 'bebs pas// mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang*// 'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos// dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na// ye shes thugs rje can gyis bzhes su gsol// dril chen gsung snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs// bsam gtan dag gis bstod de gus mchod na// sa bcu rim gyis bgrod cing thogs med cing*// tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyi rgyal por smon// mdzes sdug yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra// bsil byed tsan+dan dri dang ro brgya'i zas// mnyen 'khril pañtsa li ka reg na bde// rnam lnga'i 'don yon ji snyed mchis pas mchod// mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la longs spyod shog /lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// bde gshegs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi// zhes pas mchod la bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs thugs rjes gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed phyir zlog cing*// bde legs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// bde mchog gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal bstod// skyabs sbyin la sogs phyag rgya sna tshogs kyis// rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma dang*// ral gri mda' gzhu zhags sogs bsnams pa yi// phyag stong mnga' ba khyod la=

/dkar sngo dmar ser ljang gu'i kha dog can// sgeg pa dpa' ba 'jigs su rung ba dang*// zhi dang khro dang 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan pa'i// dbu stong mnga' ba khyod la= /dbu dang phyag sogs sku yi cha rnams la// zur gyis lta dang rnam par bgrad pa dang*// glog ltar 'khyug sogs bye ba brgya stong gi// spyan rnams mnga' ba= /rdo rje lta bur mi phyed brtan pa'i sku// dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i me phung gis// bgegs rnams 'joms shing dngos grub kun stsol ba'i// mi phyed 'bar ba= /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'bar ba'i mthus// thogs pa med cing shin tu yangs pa yi// sa gsum dkyil 'khor kun la mnga' mdzad ma// srid gsum dbang phyug= /pad 'dab shar du gzhan gyis mi thub ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis char sprin ltar gnag cing*// g.yas pa rdo rje g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gdon bgegs tshar gcod= /'dab gzhan rim par de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung*// pad+ma rdo rje nor bu glang po'i gdung*// gzhon nu klu yi gdung rnams sprul sku'i chas// mtshan bzang dpe byad 'bar la= /shar gyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar gtum chen ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gangs ri'i gdong ltar dkar// g.yas pa 'khor lo g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gzhan gyi sbyor ngan 'joms la= /lho yi pad+ma'i 'dab mar 'bar chen ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs shing*// g.yas pa rin chen g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// dus min 'chi ba 'joms la= /nub kyi pad+ma'i 'dab mar gos dkar mo// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar dmar can// g.yas pa pad+ma g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gsod dang bcings pa 'joms la= /byang gi pad+ma'i 'dab mar sgrol ma ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad ltar ljang zhing*// g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub// rmi ltas ngan pa zlog la= /byang shar 'dab mar rgyal ba'i rdo rje ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis nam mkha'i mdog mtshungs zhing*// g.yas pa dbyug pa g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// dug rnams 'joms par mdzad la=

/shar lho'i 'dab mar pad+ma'i mngon mtshan can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis gser bzang mdog mtshungs shing*// g.yas pa lcags kyu g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// mtshon gyi gnod pa zlog la= /lho nub 'dab mar gzhan gyis mi thub ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis li khri'i mdog ltar dmar// g.yas pa rdo rje'i phreng ba g.yon sdigs mdzub// me chu'i gnod pa zlog la= /nub byang 'dab mar rdo rje mchu can ma// zhal gcig phyag gnyis margad mdog mtshungs shing*// g.yas pa ral gri g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdzad// gnod sbyin srin po 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// bstan pa srung mdzad mthu stobs can// legs ldan drag po chen po ni// dka' thub las zlog drag mo dang*// lhan cig ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan nag po rdzu 'phrul can// legs ldan nag po sred med bu// phyag rgya chen po lnga rnams kyi// phyag byas pa la phyag= legs ldan nag po grong khyer ni// sum brtsegs 'jig byed dur khrod na// gnas pa ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis// phyag byas pa la= /kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag ste// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yis// tsan+dan bing dang g.yon pa na// thod pa 'dzin la= /zhabs gnyis gar gyi 'dor stabs kyis// ri rab lhun po'i steng na brjid// sku la dar nag ber chen gsol// bdud 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod// dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha// lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de= /gshin rje be con 'chang ba'i lha// ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gshin rje'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de= /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha// srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub srin po'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de=

/zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha// tshigs srung gdon gyi bdag po ste// nub phyogs chu lha 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de= /rlung ste srog kyang 'dzin pa'i lha// rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang rlung lha 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de= /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug to thogs// nor bsrung nor gyi bdag po ste// byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de= /dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha// bgegs kyi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar dbang ldan 'khor bcas la// mchod cing bstod de= /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*// zla ba nyi ma gza' chen po// gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang= /'og tu klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang*// dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa// margad mdog can pi waṃ 'dzin// dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba// yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal bstod// dpa' bo chen po stobs po che// kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin// grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba// 'phags skyes po la= /mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che// kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin// klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba// mig mi bzang la= /ded dpon chen po gser mdog can// be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin// gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba// rnam thos sras la= /bcom ldan dpa' brtan mtshon cha'i rgyal po dang*// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med// de bzhin gshegs pa mi 'khrugs rgyal po dang*// sangs rgyas sman gyi bla la= /sangs rgyas dbang po'i me tog kun tu rgyas// shākya thub pa rin chen tog gi rgyal// kun tu bzang po rnam par snang mdzad dang*// ut+pal bsung gi tog la= /gzhan yang sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun nyan thos kyi// dge 'dun zung bzhi ya brgyad drang srong tshogs// rig sngags grub pa rnams la=

/shar gyi 'khor lo khro chen rnam par rgyal// sku mdog dkar po shin tu bzhad pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad// shar phyogs gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// shar lho'i rtsibs la khro chen dbyug sngon can// sku mdog sngon po shin tu 'jigs pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas dbyug tho= /shar lho'i gdon tshogs= /lho yi 'khor lor khro rgyal gshin rje gshed// sku mdog mthing nag shin tu gdangs pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas ral gri= /lho yi= /lho nub rtsibs la khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon// sku mdog sngon po shin tu khros pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas ral gri= /lho nub= /nub kyi 'khor lor khro rgyal rta mgrin rgyal// sku mdog dmar po shin tu gtsigs pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas ral gri= /nub phyogs= /nub byang rtsibs la khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal// sku mdog dmar nag shin tu rngams pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas lcags kyu= /nub byang= /byang phyogs 'khor lor khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil// sku mdog ljang nag shin tu 'jigs pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon sdigs= /byang phyogs= /byang shar rtsibs la khro rgyal khams gsum rgyal// sku mdog nag mo shin tu khros pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas rdo rje= /byang shar= /rnam par rgyal ba'i shar du hūm̐ ka ra// sku mdog ser po shin tu rngam pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas 'khor lo= /steng phyogs= /rta mgrin rgyal po'i nub tu stobs po che// sku mdog dud ka shin tu gtsigs pa'i zhal// phyag g.yas tho ba= /'og phyogs gdon tshogs 'joms la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa rnams kyi bstod/ de nas gtor ma chu gtsang gis bran la a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i lha tshogs rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /bar byad 'grol ltar gyis phul/ gzungs nas 'byung ba'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor btags te rim gro cher mchod pa chen po byas la grong khyer gyi sgo'am/ grong ngam/ grol brdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so// 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i phyir zlog pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rim gro cher byas te btsugs na btsugs ma thag tu g.yul zhi bar byed par 'gyur ro// yams kyi nad dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro// zhes phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pas gsol ba gdab/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ ming spel gyi yi ge rnams bsrung bya dgon grong ngam gang zag lta bu skabs gang yin du bskyed/ dgug gzhug byas te dngos su mos/ bzlas pa'i skabs rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer spros mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi thugs ka nas lha mo dkar mo bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te bsrung bya rnams kyi nyer 'tshe thams cad bkrus pa dang*/ yang lha'i thugs ka nas rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros te phyi rol du rdo rje'i srung 'khor dang bsrung bya'i lus la rdo rje go cha bskon pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las bsrung zhing bskyabs par bsams la/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ gong 'khor lo bri thabs nas 'byung ba'i sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa rnams rim pa bzhin du ji tsam nus pa bzla/

de nas 'khor lo'i lha la yang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can// zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan// phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob// gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal// gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang ni// 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad dang bcas// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la// bdag nyid gus pas khyod phyag 'tshal// gdung bdun de bzhin gshegs pa bcu// rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang dang*// drang srong rig 'dzin grub rnams la// lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad sogs kyis bstod/ de nas legs ldan mched gsum gyi gtor ma chab kyis bran te 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas// mdun du sum̐ las ri rab gru bzhi pa'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ nag po re re yongs su gyur pa las/ legs ldan mched gsum sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas tsan dan gyi beng dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ dar nag gi na bza' can rang rang gi 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'og min bde chen pho brang nas// mgon po kun gshegs gdan las bzhengs// dpal ldan drag po chen po dang*// sred med bu dang nag po che// legs ldan mched gsum 'khor bcas rnams// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ oṃ ma hā kā la sha ri bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la duṣ+ṭiṃ bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la duṣ+ṭaṃ bh+yoḥ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstan pa srung mdzad mthu stobs can nas/ bdud 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bar/ dpal mgon legs ldan mched gsum khyod// sngon dus rgyal ba'i spyan sngar ni// dam bca' bzhin du rjes dgongs la// bstan pa bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// sogs dang*/ legs ldan nag po mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi bka' bzhin du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ yongs su gzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog pa dang*/ mtshon cha rnams spang bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyis shig ces brjod/ de nas cha gsum gtor ma spyi ltar gtang*/ slar yang nam mkha'i lha la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis gong ltar mchod cing bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i sogs gzungs nas 'byung bas gsol ba btab pas/ lha rnams dngos grub stsol ba'i slad du dgyes bzhin 'od du zhu nas bris pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lha mo gtso 'khor la thim/ thugs rje'i 'od zer kun tu khyab pas sngags kyi yig 'bru mthu dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs shing yongs su gyur pa las sa bon gyi rnam par bsams la/ de nas/ phyogs bcu na sogs nas bye brag tu srung ba'i 'khor lo 'di la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs sogs kha bsgyur ba'i su pra tiṣ+ṭha'i bar lan gsum brjod pas brtan bzhugs bya/ ston mchog dam pa sogs mdo rgyud nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis brjod cing me tog 'thor bar bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis thun gsum mam bzhir bcad de zhag gsum mam bdun sogs su bsgrub/

thun phyi ma rnams la sa bon las mi bskyed par sngar yod gsal 'debs kyi tshul du bya/ sgrub grogs mang po yod na sngags rgyun ma chad par byas na legs/ de ltar rgyas bsdus gang yang rung bas legs par bsgrub zin pa'i 'khor lo nyid tshul bzhin bltabs la tshon skud sna lngas dkris te rin po che'i gwa'u la sogs par bcug pa'am skabs dang bstun par bya'o// de nas rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i lag len dngos ni/ spyir rgyal mtshan la bum pa'i rnam pa/ ba dan gyi rnam pa/ dril bu'i rnam pa ste gsum las/ phyi ma nyid grags che bas dar ras kyi rgyal mtshan yin na thog mar srog shing dri bzang po'i shing las byas pa la/ oṃ badz+ra ā yuḥṣe swā hā/ zhes bri/ tog gi nang du gdugs dkar gyi sku'am/ gzungs rnams zhal phyir bstan dbu nas dril la gzhug rgyal mtshan gyi thod nang du 'khor lo bris la sbyar/ mi shong ba'am 'jig pa'i nyen yod na bltabs la dar skud gyis rgya gram du bcings la/ lte ba'i oṃ mgo mjug ma nor bar rang phyogs la bstan nas gzhug 'byor na tog gi nang du 'phel gdung sogs byin rlabs yod nges dang*/ gdugs dkar gyi gzungs/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan/ mdo las byung ba'i bkra shis/ sa rdo sman 'bru sogs gos dar gyis dril gzhug tog gi mtshams nas dar ras kyi 'phur ma lhab lhub tu g.yo ba dril bu'i rnam par bskon/ zangs rag dang shing sogs kyi gañdzi ra yin na sngar gyi steng du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos skyong nor lha'i gzungs dang*/ gnod sbyin 'khor lo sogs 'bul tshul mchod rten ltar byas la/ bcas zin pa'i rgyal mtshan de nyid maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su 'dzugs/ gtor ma cog zlum dkar po lnga/ chu gnyis nyer mchod sogs/ phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag gtor ma/ bgegs gtor/ byur dang sdig sbyang*/ khrus gsol gyi chas/ mig thur/ mig sman/

rdor dril/ rol chen/ gangs bzang*/ gu gul sogs yo byad rnams 'du byas/ gso sbyong blang*/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ oṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ji snyed yod pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod yon la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas so sor snang ba/ ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nus pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig thal mo khong stong snying gar bcas bskor bzhin du rim gyis btegs la mthar dpral bar se gol gtogs nas bkrol ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ sarba bit+pū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da rnams bcug rol chen gyi bar dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba de badz+ra sā ra pra marda ne/ ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te saṃ myak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dza badz+re/ ma hā bing+ya badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ sngon 'gro gtor ma gong ltar btang*/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi ltar song nas/ rang skad cig gis gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i gtsug tor gdugs dkar mor gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan gzhan gyis mi thub ma la bla ma rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pas dbu la brgyan par sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drang*/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhi ma khro mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba lang tsho dar la bab pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon gdugs dkar po'i yu ba nas bzung zhing rin po che dang dar gyi na bza' gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor oṃ dkar pos mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ khyed kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan cing dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par bsam/ rang gi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul/ sems can rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ log par 'dren pa'i tshogs kyi nus mthu rnams zhi bar byas te tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ tad+ya thā/ a na le a na le/ bi shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ bai ra bai ra/ badz+ra dha ri ṇi/ ban dha ban dha/ badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa/ hūm̐ drūm̐ ban dha ban dha phaṭa/ hūm̐ drūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das ma bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dza/ hūm̐ ye shes bskal pa nas/ bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal mtshan cho ga'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i nas/ bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za/ gtor zlum bzhi ting lo dang bcas pa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣas bsang*/ badz+ra a na les sbyang*/ a kā ros brlab/ sarba bigh+nāṃ na maḥsogs kyis gtor ma rten la g.yon dang g.yas su gnyis gnyis bskor te dor/ de bzhin sum+bha bzla zhing mar me bzhi/ byur dang bkra mi shis pa sbyang ba'i ched du rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams la sbyang ba byas pa'i thugs mos gnang ba zhu/ mchod yon bzed zhal du phul te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā/ bdug spos shangs la phul te/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe swā hā/ mar me spyan la phul te/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā/ dri chab 'thor g.yab kyis thugs kar 'thor tshul byas te/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā/ zhal zas mdun du phul te/

oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ya swā hā/ yungs kar khu tshur gyis bzung bas g.yon dang g.yas su bskor te/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ g.yas phyogs kyi me dang g.yon phyogs kyi chur dor/ de bzhin du chu bzung bas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ku ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces g.yas g.yon du bskor ba snod du dor/ sngags gnyis sbyor ba 'og ma rnams la 'gre/ kham phor dkar po bzung ste/ dūrba lci chang dang bcas pa bzung*/ zan chang zung ser ras zung bcas pa snod du dor/ rab tu gnas bya'i rten rnams kha sna mig sna kha lag mgo bo lte ba rnams su reg ces pa ltar chu gtsang g.yon pa'i khyor bar blugs/ g.yas pa'i gung srin gyis nye reg byas pa'i chu lhag snod du dor/ thugs kar dri phul te yak+ṣa dang 'bul tshul gong bzhin/ de bzhin du yak+ṣa gong du sbyar ba 'gre ba'i me tog dang mchod yon 'bul/ mar me gnyis gnyis khyer nas bskor ba sogs gong bzhin/ 'bras bu'i tshogs kyis byabs/ spos dkar dang mar bsregs pa'i dud pas bdugs te yak+ṣa dang las sngags bzla/ thams cad lhag ma ma lus par snod du dor/ phyag rgya dang bcas/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang khyad par bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i= gsang sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis 'dir rgyal mtshan bsgrub cing 'dzugs pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs log par 'tshe ba'i tshogs rnams la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas pa yin pas 'dis mgu zhing tshim par gyis la zhi ba byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas rang rang gi gnas dang rten la song zhig

gal te mi 'gro na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro// a na le sogs dang hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ me a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar po rgyar khru gang ba/ zabs su khru phyed/ mu khyud kha khyer sor bzhis bskor ba'i kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i ye shes kyi thab khung de'i nang du raṃ las ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa zhal gdangs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che// zhes sh+lo gcig gis bstod/ rang gi mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi dbus su yi ge hūm̐ 'bar ba re res mtshan par gyur/ til/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ lan bdun tsam brjod pas phul/ slar yang mchod bstod byas/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// ces sogs dang*/ badz+ra mu/ thab kyi lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag nyid la thim par gyur/ khrus gsol ni/ 'di'i bum pa bsgrubs zin yod na'am/ med na 'di nyid kyi bum chog ltar bsgrub nas/ khrus byas 'du byas la/ thog mar rten ring bsrel gyi snying po can la/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan dang*/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ ri bo ltar ni mdzes pa yi// yon tan dam pa'i rgyan ldan pa// mchod gnas rin chen khyed rnams la// bdag cag dad pas sku khrus gsol// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la sogs sngags bcas dang*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pa'i sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes sku phyi/ khrus chu bum par blugs pas rgyal mtshan la/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba= 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// sogs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la sogs sngags bcas dang*/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu sogs phar phyin drug khrus kyi mjug tu sku phyi bya'o// de nas rgyal mtshan la a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las gdugs dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas zhal sngo ba/ g.yon zhal dmar ba/ zhal re re bzhin spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas kyi dang po na gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na mda'/ bzhi pa na dgra s+t+wa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na rgyal mtshan/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad zla'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ khros pa'i stang stabs kyis ma rungs pa thams cad 'jigs shing 'jigs par byed pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/

de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ gi gong āḥ'i 'og tu zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rnga brdungs dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la// sum cu rtsa gsum gnas rigs su// nad kyi bskal pas zhig la khad// bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis// bsrung zhing skyob pa'i las mdzad nas// ma mo thams cad dbang du sdud// de yi spyi bo'i gtsug tu nub// stong gsum thams cad spyan gyis gzigs// de la ming dang mtshan gsol ba// gtsug tor nor bu'i gdugs dkar mo// sngon dus 'phrin las mdzad pa ltar// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs// chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs su gsol// bskul lo sems can don la bskul// sems can don la bskul gyis gshegs// rgyal dang chom rkun me dang chu// dug mtshon pha rol dmag dpung dang*// mu ge dgra dang lce 'bab 'jigs// thams cad ldog phyir gshegs su gsol// zhes pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi= dge 'dun gyi= rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi= bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi= sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi/ dpal ldan dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi/ bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin 'brangs nas rgyal mtshan rab tu gnas par byed pa dang*/ bde ba mchog gi lam la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par dengs shig thams cad 'joms pa'i sngags dang*/ gtso mo'i sngags dang*/ a mṛ ta sogs brjod cing rol mo drag po dang bcas pa'i tsham rngam dang*/

yungs kar gyis rten brab/ gu gul gyis bdug pa rnams bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs kyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rdor dril spos dang bcas pa 'dzin pas/ zhwa phud ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// nas/ mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// gyi bar dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkha' byon par gyur/ ces dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ sogs nas/ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par thim par gyur par gong ltar/ yang thugs ka'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rigs lngas dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa/ yum lngas dbang bskur ba dang*/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po zhes pa'i tshig bcad rnams rnal 'byor bla med kyi lugs yin pas 'dir 'bri ru mi rung ngo zhes yid ches khungs btsun pas so/ dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣeñtsa tu twāṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag lus ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang*/ chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams de nyid du thim/ de nas gser sogs kyi mig thur gyis/ dngul ltong sogs su bkod pa'i mar dang sbrang rtsi blangs nas/ me long la lha'i gzugs brnyan bsgoms pa la spyan la byug cing*/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// rgyal ba rnams kyis khyod kyi ni// mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal// oṃ tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu sa man+ta tsak+ṣu bi sho dha ne swā hā/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog
