/zhi ba la sogs pa'i don du yon bdag la sogs pa sems can thams cad la gzigs pa lhur byed pa dang ldan par gyur/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin gyis brlabs/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang sogs nas/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi// zhes pa'i bar gong ltar gyis mchod la/ bde chen dbang phyug mchog gi gtso// zhal gsum rtsa zhal kun+dā'i mdog /g.yas sngo g.yon dmar khro zhing 'dzum// gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo// gdugs dkar rdo rje mda' dang ni// dgra s+t+wa g.yas kyi phyag gis 'dzin// rgyal mtshan 'khor lo gzhu zhags pa// g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog gangs kyi ri ltar dkar// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// 'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob// gtsug tor las byung khyod la bstod// ces pas bstod/ gtor ma dang po rgyal mtshan lhar bskyed pa la dbul te/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ gong 'og tu gtor ma byin rlabs dgos pa dmigs bsal med pa thams cad 'dis 'gre'o// a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i ljags hūm̐ las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes par gyur/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma dbul/ oṃ sarba ta tha gā toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can// zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan// phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob// gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal// bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/

yul phyogs 'dir mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang*/ yams nad dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad phyir bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig gtor ma gnyis pa byin gyis brlabs/ drag rgyal ma dang rgyal po sku lnga'i gsol mchod gtong gsungs pa zhwa lu pa rang lugs la dgongs kyi gzhan du rang rang gi chos skyong gtor bsngo gtong*/ gtor ma gsum pa byin brlabs pa/ legs ldan mched gsum la gong 'khor lo'i skabs ltar dbul/ gtor ma bzhi pa byin gyis brlabs la/ ri rab lhun po'i phyogs bzhi nas// rgyal po chen po sde bzhi ni// yul 'khor srung dang 'phags skyes po// spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras// btsun mo sras dang 'khor gyi tshogs// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ma hā rā dza tsa tur+sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ dhṛ ta rāṣ+ṭā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai rū ḍha kā ya swā hā/ oṃ bi rū bāk+ṣā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shrā wa ṇā ya swā hā/ sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥsogs lan gsum gyis phul/ ma hā rā dza tsa tur+sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor skyong*// sku mdog dkar bas zhi ba 'grub// thugs rje chen pos pi waṃ 'dzin// shar phyogs dri za dbang du sdus// 'khor 'dir gnod pa med par mdzod// rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po// mngon spyod tshul gyis 'gro don mdzad// dug gsum gcod pa'i ral gri bsnams// lho phyogs grul bum dbang du sdus// 'khor 'dir= /rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang*// dbang sdud dmar smug 'jigs pa'i sku// nus pa'i mthu rdzogs zhags pa bsnams// nub phyogs klu rnams dbang du sdus// 'khor 'dir= /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras// che ba'i yon tan rgyas pa'i sku// rin chen gter ldan ne'u le 'dzin// byang phyogs gnod sbyin dbang du sdud// 'khor 'dir=

/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// sogs kyi rjes su/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gis sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa la/ shar phyogs dri za'i gdon las gyur pa'i nad dang gnod pa dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang*/ rgyal po 'phags skyes pos lho phyogs grul bum gyi gdon las gyur pa'i nad dang gnod pa dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang*/ spyan mi bzang gis nub phyogs klu'i gdon las gyur pa'i nad dang gnod pa dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang*/ rnam thos sras kyis byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi gdon las gyur pa'i nad dang gnod pa dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mdor na rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi bka' bzhin du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ yongs su bzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog pa dang*/ mtshon cha rnams spangs par gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyis shig rol mo drag po/ gtor ma lnga pa byin brlab/ phyogs bcu skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang*// brgya byin gshin rje chu lha dang*// nor bdag dbang ldan mo yi lha// srin po dang ni rlung lha dang*// sa yi lha mo brtan ma ste// phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas kyang*// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ in+d+rā ye swā hā/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ oṃ ya mā ye swā hā/ oṃ nair ṛ t+ya swā hā/ oṃ ba ru ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ wa ya we swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ī shwa nā ya swā hā/ oṃ brah+ma ṇe swā hā/ oṃ sūr+ya ye swā hā/ oṃ tsan+dā ya swā hā/

oṃ pri thi wī bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ nā ge bh+yaḥswā hā/ oṃ a su re bh+yaḥswā hā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha sogs nas/ mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba gdugs dkar mo can gyi bka' bzhin du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la srung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ yongs su bzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog pa dang*/ mtshon cha rnams spang bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyis shig oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ gtor ma drug pa brlab/ oṃ yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po sarba sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ yul bdag grong bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥsogs lan gsum gyis phul rjes/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni/ spyir 'dzam bu gling bye ba phrag brgya na gnas pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/ lha klu gnod sbyin 'brog gnas dang 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis/ khyad par yul phyogs 'di nyid dang gnas khang 'di nyid na gnas pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo// ru nga ba phrag dog pa sdod na bskul ba/ 'gro na bshol 'debs la sogs pa gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thams cad spongs/

gzhis bzang po chos ldan du skyong ba'i gnas po mdzod cig gnas mgron gyi dam tshig srungs/ 'gal rkyen thams cad spongs/ mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub pa'i phrin las rgya chen po mdzod cig yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi bka' bzhin du yul phyogs 'dir mi nad dang phyugs nad dang yams nad dang 'tshe ba dang gnod pa dang 'khrugs pa dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad phyir bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig gtor ma bdun pa brlab/ thal mo khong stong oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas gtor ma'i rdzas so so'i nyes skyon gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs par gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yoḥ nas/ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas bdud rtsi phun sum tshogs par gyur/ lag pa thal mo phyir bskyed mthe bong bsnol sor mo gzhan rnams so sor brkyang ba oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas gang mos bsgyur bar gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ zhes pas 'dod yon la sogs pa thams cad longs spyod nus par gyur/ lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur snying gar bzhag g.yon mchog sbyin gyis snod 'debs pa'i tshul de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur yin nam oṃ dzñā na a ba lo ki te sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi bhā ba sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hṛ da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ zhes pas mgron rnams kyis so sor thob par gyur/ lag pa thal mo khong stong las rdo rje nang bsdam mthe bong gshibs te brkyang na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ gra he sha ri pra bhañdza na maḥs man+ta swā hā/ zhes pa'i sri zhu dang yon tan gyi mgron dang snying rje dang lan chags kyi mgron thams cad dam tshig dbang gis bdag la 'go zhing stong grogs su 'gyur zhing sems can thams cad kyi don du las ci bcol ba 'grub par gyur cig

de nas gdon chen nyer brgyad spyan drang bar bya ste/ mi sdug 'tshe ba'i ngang tshul can// gdon chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad de// gzi brjid 'phrog dang mdangs 'phrog pa// mngal dang khrag zhag za ba dang*// tshil za rkang dang btsas pa za// srog 'phrog pa dang gtor ma za// phreng ba dri dang bdug pa za// me tog 'bru dang lo tog za// sbyin sreg phyi sa rnag za ba// gcin 'thung mchil ma lhag ma za// snabs za ngar snabs mi gtsang za// stor khung 'bab 'thung skyug pa za// de ltar gnod byed 'khor dang bcas// mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// e h+ye his spyan drang*/ gdon chen gnod byed nyer brgyad la// mthun pa'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs par gyis// ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gzi brjid 'phrog dang mdangs za la// gzugs brnyan khrag snas brgyan pa 'bul// mngal za ba la mngar gsum rtsi// khrag 'thung ba la khrag sna 'bul// zhag za ba la zhag dang bcud// sha za ba la sha yi tshogs// tshil za ba la phyi nang tshil// rkang za ba la rkang mar 'bul// btsas za ba la bu ram dang*// shin kun sbyar ba 'di dag 'bul// srog 'phrog pa la 'o ma dang*// zho dang ka ra bcas pa 'bul// skyug pa za la sbrang rtsi dang*// mi gtsang za la sgog btsong dang*// la phug rgyu rkyen sbyar ba 'bul// gcin pa 'thung la rgun 'brum chang*// 'bras chang bcud dang ldan pa 'bul// stor khung nas 'bab 'thung ba la// 'bru sna mang po bcud sbyar 'bul// lhag ma za la rdzas kun gyi// lhag ma bsdus la dbul bar bya// mchil ma 'thung la dang bcud dang*// bya mo'i sgo nga snabs za la// ngar sgong ngar snabs za la 'bul// rnag za ba la sha rul dang*// gtor ma za la 'khur ba dang*// rab tu sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'bul// phreng ba za la ru rak+ṣa// bo dhi tsit+ta la sogs 'bul// dri za ba la ga bur dang*// bzang sman drug dang bcas pa 'bul// bdug pa za la sbyar spos bdug

/dri dang 'bras bur bcas pa 'bul// sems 'phrog pa la sha khrag chang*// sgog btsong bcas pa'i gtor ma 'bul// me tog za la me tog rigs// 'bras bu za la bu ram dang*// shing tog sna tshogs bcas pa 'bul// lo tog za la 'bru bzang dang*// 'bras dang nas kyi snye ma 'bul// sbyin sreg za la 'bru bcud dang*// 'bras kyi lag ban dbul bar bya// rang rang mthun rdzas 'di bzhes la// gnod pa'i bsam sbyor zhi ba dang*// phan pa'i bsam pa ldan par gyis// bde legs thams cad 'byung bar mdzod// de nas rgya chen shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags lan gsum dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan lan gsum brjod la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ 'byung po'i tshogs gang su dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang nas/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bdag la nyon cig bar gong ltar/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen po'i rigs sngags las 'byung ba bzhin khyed rnams spos dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ gtor ma'ang sbyin no// mchod gtor 'di rnams kyis mgu bar gyis la bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad zhi ba dang bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog pa dang*/ dug zhi ba dang*/ mtshams bcad pa dang*/ yongs su bsrung ba dang*/ chad pa thams cad bzlog par mdzod cig rgyal po dang*/ chom rkun dang me'am/ chu'am/ dug gam/ mi mdza' ba'am/ lam gol par 'gro ba'am/ gnyid log pa'am/ ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa thams cad las bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bsrung bar gyis shig bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang nas/ gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa de dag thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gzi brjid 'phrog pa thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad bzlog par gyur cig

gdon thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gnod pa thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rig sngags chen mo'i mthus/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad gdon thams cad dang gnod pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig swā hā/ zhes rol mo'i sgra drag po bya'o// de nas rgyal mtshan gyi tog la gzungs thag btags te/ de'i sne mo gcig nas slob dpon grogs dang bcas pas bzung la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa a ba lo ki mur+dha te dza ra shi/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khā da khā da/ dha ka dha ka da ra da ra/ bin+dha bin+dha/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes snying po dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes nye snying dang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bi sha dhe bi sha dhe/ bai ra bai ra/ badz+ra dha ri/ ban+dha ban+dha/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ drūm̐ phaṭa/ bhan+dha phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ sarba budha a dhiṣ+ṭha nā a dhiṣ+ṭhi te swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bsnyen sngags dang*/ oṃ a si tā na lārka pra bha s+phu ṭa si tā ta pa tre/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khā da khā da/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha/ bin+dha bin+dha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ he ho phaṭa/ he ho phaṭa/ a mo ghe phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta phaṭa/ ba ra da phaṭa/ ba ra pra da ya phaṭa/ pra t+yaṃ gi ri ti phaṭa/ a su ra bi drā ba ka phaṭa/ sarba de be bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba na ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a su re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba martu bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ga ru ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba gan+dhar+bhe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kan+na re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma ho ra nā ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba yak+ṣe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba rāk+ṣa se bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pre te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pi shā tsi bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bhū te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kum+bheṇ+ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pū ta ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/

sarba ka ṭa pū ta ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba skan+de bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba un+mā te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ts+tsha ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a pa smā re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba o s+t+wa ra ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba durlaṃ gi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba duṣ+pe k+ṣi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba dz+wa re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kṛ t+ya karma kā khorde bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ki ra ṇa be tā ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsi ts+tsha pre sha ka dush+tsa dhi bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba dur+bhuk+te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba tīr+tha ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba shra ma ṇe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bid+yā dha re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ dza ya ka ra ma dhu ka re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ar+tha sā dha ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bid+yā tsa re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsa tur+bha gi ni bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kau mā ri ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ bid+yā rā dzñi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ ma hā pra t+yaṃ gi re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ badz+ra shriṃ kha lā ya pra t+yaṃ gi re rā dzā ya phaṭa/ ma hā kā lā ya mā tri ga ṇa na maskṛ ta ye phaṭa/ bi ṣ+ṇa bī ye phaṭa/ brah+ma ṇī ye phaṭa/ ag+ni ye phaṭa/ ma hā kā li ye phaṭa/ kā li daṇ+ḍī ye phaṭa/ ain+d+ri ye phaṭa/ rau dri yī ye phaṭa/ kau mā rī ye phaṭa/ bā rā hī ye phaṭa/ tsā muṇ+ḍi ye phaṭa/ rā tri ye phaṭa/ kā la rā trī ye phaṭa/ ya ma dan+ḍī ye phaṭa/ ka pā li ye phaṭa/ a dhi muk+ti sh+ma shā na bā si ni ye phaṭa/

phyir zlog chung ba las byung ba zhwa lu lo chen gyis zhu dag mdzad pa ltar bris/ mchog grub ma dang mi gcig par snang ngo*// zhes gzungs ring ngo*// de nas bcos ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo sogs nas/ zhi bar 'gyur ro// zhes phan yon ji skad bka' stsal ba thams cad sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa'i bar gong ltar 'dod gsol brjod cing rgyal mtshan la me tog gtor/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i ye shes kyi sku de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par gyur/ ces brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can// zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan// phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob// gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes mchod cing bstod nas rgyal mtshan rol mo dang bcas grong dang*/ khang pa'i nang sogs la skor rjes khang thog shar du khyer te gtso mo/ legs ldan/ yul 'khor srung rnams la mchod gtor bshams nas brlab/ gtso mo legs ldan mched gsum rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs gsum/ oṃ ma hā kā la sha ri bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la duṣ+ṭi bh+yoḥ ma hā kā la duṣ+ṭaṃ bh+yoḥs pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum dang*/ oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rāṣ+ṭa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ sogs kyis yul 'khor srung la phul/ thun mong du oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dril bu sum rdung*/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can// sogs dang*/

bstan pa srung mdzad bgegs dpung 'joms// gzhan gyis mi thub stobs po che// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig can// legs ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa// margad mdog mtshungs pi waṃ 'dzin// dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba// yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ 'di la dpon slob rnams bzhengs la rgyal mtshan la phyogs pas rnga rdung dbyangs dang bcas pa bya'o// sngon gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs ni// nag po chen pos 'jig pa'i tshe// bde gshegs sprul sku'i gtsug tor nas// gdugs dkar can gyi lha mo sprul// gtsug tor gdugs dkar byin rlabs kyis// nag po chen po dam la btags// nag po chen po mnyes byas nas// grong khyer sum brtsegs brtan par byas// sum brtsegs pa yi mi rnams ni// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bzlog /hūm̐/ dam can sgrub mchog bdag gis kyang*// gtsug tor gdugs dkar can ma la// mchod dang gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi// mchod dang gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /grong khyer chen po sum brtsegs bzhin// grong khyer 'di yang bsrung du gsol// sum brtsegs pa yi mi bzhin du// grong khyer 'di ni gnas pa yi// bzhugs dang mi bzhugs thams cad kyi// mi mthun bar chad bzlog tu gsol// gzhan gyis bsgrub pa'i rig sngags zlog /gzhan gyis rbad pa'i pho nya bzlog /rgyal mtshan 'di yi nus pa yis// shar phyogs cha 'di bsrung du gsol// shar gyi gdon tshogs phyir zlog cig /'byor dang bkra shis tshur stsol zhig /shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung*// dri za'i tshogs dang bcas pa la// rgyal mtshan 'di ni gnyer du 'bul// srung zhing skyob pa'i phrin las mdzod// grong khyer 'di yi shar phyogs su// rgyal mtshan 'di ni btsugs pa yis// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzod// ces brjod la rgyal mtshan lnga la sogs pa yod na shar phyogs su 'dzugs rgyu'i rgyal mtshan de nyid du btsugs la/

phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar de srid du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu sku gsung thugs kyi rten 'di la sa dang*/ chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar de srid du sems can gyi don dpag tu med par mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan bzhugs dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ de nas lho la sogs pa'i phyogs gzhan du 'dzugs rgyu so so yod na de dag phyogs de dang der rim bzhin khyer/ gcig las med na de nyid phyogs so sor khyer la/ gtor 'bul nas brtsams shis brjod kyi bar shar gyi de gzhir bzhag pa la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par lho phyogs su/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skye po 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ bai rā bha ka sa pa ri wā ra/ dpa' bo chen po stobs po che// kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin// grul bum tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba// 'phags skyes po la phyag 'tshal lo// lho phyogs cha 'di bsrung du gsol// lho yi gdon tshogs phyir zlog cig /'byor dang bkra shis tshul stsol zhig /lho phyogs rgyal po'i 'phags skyes po// grul bum tshogs dang bcas pa la// dang*/ grong khyer 'di yi lho phyogs su// sogs/ nub tu/ mig mi bzang*/ bai rū pāk+ṣa/ mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che// kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin// klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba// spyan mi bzang la phyag 'tshal lo// nub phyogs/ nub kyi/ nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang*// klu yi tshogs= grong khyer 'di yi nub phyogs su// sogs/ byang du/ rnam thos sras/ bai shra ba ṇa/ sde dpon chen po gser mdog can// be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin// gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i// rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo// byang phyogs cha/

byang gi gdon/ byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras// gnod sbyin tshogs dang bcas= grong khyer 'di yi byang phyogs su// sogs ma nor bar sbyar/ de nas mthar rgyal mtshan de nyid sngar gyi 'dzugs sa rnying pa yod na de nyid du btsugs/ shar du 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs shar phyogs su bstan pa sogs 'gre/ tog la sku dngos yod na phugs su zhal bstan no// med na sgo khang steng du legs par btsugs/ rlung sogs kyi mi bsgul bar brtan par byas/ de la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bde chen dbang phyug mchog gi gtso// zhal gsum rtsa zhal kun+da'i mdog /g.yas sngo g.yon dmar khro zhing 'dzum// gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo// gdugs dkar rdo rje mda' dang ni// dgra s+t+wa g.yas kyi phyag gis 'dzin// rgyal mtshan 'khor lo gzhu zhags pa// g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sku mdog gangs kyi ri ltar dkar// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// 'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob// gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes pas bstod/ de nas sbyin bdag dang bcas pas lag tu me tog thogs la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi rgyud las byung ba bzhin du rgyal mtshan bzhengs su gsol/ mchod pa'i tshogs ci 'byor pa bshams nas 'phags pa'i tshogs spyan drangs shing mchod bstod gtor ma phul te gsol ba btab pa dang*/

gzungs sngags bzlas shing 'byung po rnams gtor mas tshim par byas pa'i mthus/ sbyin pa'i bdag po la sogs pa thams cad kyi nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ rims dang*/ dgra dang*/ bgegs dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs la sogs pa 'gal rkyen spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ mdor na sngon sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas lha gnas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi chos bzang lha'i 'dun sa ru dpal gyi mgur nas 'di skad du/ mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang*/ yams kyi nad dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa thams cad dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te rim gro cher mchod pa chen po byas la grong khyer ram/ grong ngam/ grong brdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so// 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa chen mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rim gro cher byas te btsugs na btsugs ma thag tu g.yul zhi bar byas par 'gyur ro// yams kyi nad dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad zhi bar 'gyur ro// zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad sbyin pa'i bdag po la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis 'phral du thob par gyur cig gzhan yang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa tshad mar gyur pas ji skad bka' stsal pa bzhin bden pa mngon sum du bstan pa ci gnang*/ gzungs las gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams// sbyin bdag dang ni 'gro kun la// dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyis// 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes brjod la rgyal mtshan la me tog gtor/

ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni// dga' ldan du ni gnas pa la// lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums zhugs ltar// de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu// 'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas// byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang*// yon gyi bdag po'i don slad du// bdag gi 'byor pa 'di nyid kyi// ci 'byor ba yis mchod pa dang*// me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang sbyin bdag bcas pa la// rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs nas// kun gyis 'di la byin brlab cing*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs// phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i nas/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bde gshegs kun bzang mthong bas bkra shis ltar// rgyal ba 'khor bcas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /ngan sdig log pa'i tshogs rnams bcom gyur nas// rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshogs rnams 'phel dar zhing*// zhal mthong tsam gyis bde ba'i mchog brnyes nas// nyi ltar zhal gro zla ltar 'od gsal zhing*// bstan dang 'gro la zhal dro byin che nas// bskal pa'i mthar thug bar du bzhugs su gsol// ji srid me dang chu dang ni// rlung gi bskal pas 'jig bar du// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod// yig brgya bdun brjod/ mgon po skal ba ji bzhin du// sna tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su// des ni 'gro don kun tu mdzod// ces brtan bzhugs kyi tshig dang*/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod par bya'o// sgrub mchod dang 'brel ba la ni/ thog mar 'khor lo sogs bca' gzhi legs par bsgrigs nas/ 'khor lo la rab gnas mdor bsdus dgos pas bdag bskyed gang rung dang khrus bum bsgrub/ sbyong khrus sngon 'gros 'od dpag med kyi rigs su bskyed pa sogs spyi ltar/ de nas rgyal mtshan gyi gzungs gzhug tshags su tshud rjes rgyal mtshan la rab gnas shig dgos pas/

bdag bskyed gang rigs sngon 'gro'i sbyong khrus/ rgyal mtshan 'khor lo dang bcas pa 'od dpag med par bskyed pa sogs rab gnas mdor bsdus brtan bzhugs shis brjod bar mthar dbyung*/ de nas rgyal mtshan sgrub rgyur dpon slob lnga las mi nyung bas nyin bdun nam lngar gdugs dkar nyer bdun sgrub mchod dang 'brel bar bya dgos pas/ nyin dang po la ras bris sgrub mchod sta gon/ nyin gnyis pa la/ sgrub mchod dngos gzhi bdag bskyed mdun bskyed tshar mtshams/ rgyal mtshan mdun bskyed ltar bskyed cing mchod bstod bar/ de mtshams mdun bskyed brten byed tshul du sngags yongs rdzogs tshar gsum tsam dang*/ gzungs dngos rgya rtsa brgyad las mi nyung bar bzla/ rten snying de mtshungs/ 'di skabs gzungs thag gzung rgyu dang*/ mjug tu rten snying bzlas pa'i me tog 'thor/ rol mo bya/ mjug tu phrin bcol gzhung gsal ltar/ de nas bdag 'jug dang sgrub mchod mthar dbyung ba'i gtong rag brtan bzhugs skabs/ ras bris brtan bzhugs dkyus ltar rjes/ rgyal mtshan la brtan bzhugs nan tan bya/ nyin gsum pa man chad la/ rgyal mtshan bskyed chog zur du ma grub na mdun bskyed ras bris dang lhan cig bskyed kyang chog de ltar sgrub mchod tshar dus snye mdo pa'i yig cha gzhir bzhag gi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs chog byed/ 'di la rgyal mtshan dgu'am lnga yod dngos rgyu dang*/ cis kyang ma 'dzom na rgyal mtshan gcig phyogs bzhir khyer rgyu mdzad 'dug kyang*/ mi lcogs pa'am khur thabs med na phyogs bzhir ras kyi rgyal mtshan bzhi med thabs med/ de la'ang gzungs gzhug bsdus pa tsam dang*/ lhag par gdugs dkar 'khor lo cha gsum lnga re tsam bzhag dgos/ de'ang rab gnas dgos stabs dang po nas gzungs gzhug sogs tshags su tshud par byas te rgyal mtshan chen mo'i phyogs bzhir btsugs/ rab gnas dang rgyal mtshan sgrub pa sogs mnyam du byed dgos pas de lugs kyi bca' gzhi legs 'grigs gal che/

de nas gdugs dkar rgyal mtshan 'dzugs tshar 'phral/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i rig pa bzhugs pa'i cho ga zur gsal ltar/ de nas rab gnas dngos gzhi'i sngon du dri med rnam gnyis byed na/ nyin dang po la gtsug tor dri med cho ga gzhung gsal ltar/ nyin gnyis pa la 'od dri cho ga gzhung gsal ltar/ nyin gsum pa man rab gnas cho ga rgyas bsdus gang rigs byas pas 'grub/ 'di skabs spyir bskyed chog gzhung gsal ltar las bsnon 'phri med kyang*/ rgyal mtshan ni yon tan gyi rten red pas rin 'byung gi rigs su bskyed dgos pa lags/ zhes rje bla ma'i zin bris las so// de nas bsgrub bya srung ba'i 'khor lo la/ de nyid dmigs bsal byed par spro na/ thog mar bri tshul yang dbus kyi pad+ma 'dab brgyad dor ba sogs gzhung gsal ltar dang*/ sgrub skabs bskyed chog kyang de dang mthun par/ stong pa'i ngang las me phung dang rdo rje'i rwa ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du chud pa'i mu khyud nyis rim/ de'i nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad nyis rim/ de'i lte bar oṃ yongs su gyur pa las sogs kha bsgyur shes par byas la tshul bzhin bsgrub/ de nas yul khams srung ba dang gzhi mthun can gyi 'khor lo'am/ 'di nyid sger gyi srung 'khor gang yin kyang 'dogs pa'i tshul ni/ bsgrub bya mdun du 'khod pa la sbyong khrus sngon du 'gro bas/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs kyi spyan sngar tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa'i slad du lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul te phyag 'tshal ba'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ji snyed su dag sogs/ bde gshegs gtsug tor sogs/ phyag byar 'os pa sogs/ de nas skyabs yul de rnams kyi spyan sngar skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa len snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ byang chub snying por sogs lan gsum gyis phog la/

bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces dus thams cad du gsol ba thob cig ces bsgos la/ de dang slob dpon lhan cig pas byin gyis brlab par bsams la sngags kyis btab pa'i yungs kar gyi thum po dang bcas dkar po'am yon bdag gi khams mthun gyi dar gyis dril te btags nas oṃ a na le sogs dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang legs ldan mched gsum/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la sogs pa'i gdung bdun dang*/ sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa bcu/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos dgra bcom pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis bsgrub bya 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad las bsrung ba dang*/ khyad par du gzhan gyi rig sngags kyis byas pa'i byad ka rbod gtong mnan gtad gzer gsum la sogs pa thams cad las bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba'i phrin las dam pa mdzad du gsol/ 'di nyid kyi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang bde blag tu 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bka' bsgos pas srung 'khor gnam lcags rdo rje'i gur khang du khyed rang rnams tshud pa la brten nas/ phyin chad bdud dang log 'dren gang gis kyang glags mi rnyed par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces byas la/ rgyal ba sras bcas sogs la/ bcom ldan gdugs dkar can gyi nus mthu yis// zhes kha bsgyur ba'i bden tshig dang*/

bkra shis brjod par bya'o// gal te dbang dang 'brel na phun sum tshogs par 'gyur la/ rjes gnang dang 'brel bar byed na'ang rung bas/ rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub 'phral sbyong khrus sogs ji skad bshad pa ltar byas la gdags/ de bzhin du byad 'grol sogs dang sbrel tshul kyang rigs pa'i 'phrul shes par bya ste yig char gsal ba ltar ro// de ltar btags pa'i phan yon ni mtshon dang me la sogs pa'i gnod pas mi tshugs pa la sogs pa gzhung nas gsungs pa thams cad 'byung ba ni nges pa'o// 'khor lo bri tshul cung zad mthun min byung ba ni lugs so sor shes par bya'i mtha' gcig tu 'dzin mi dgos so// gtsug tor las 'khrungs bcom ldan 'das ma yi// me ri 'bar ba 'khor lo'i gur khang dang*// g.yul las rgyal byed rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba'i tshul// bris dges bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i stobs ldan shog /ces pa 'di'ang kun gzigs rje bla ma de nyid kyi gsung bkod ltar sngags 'chang shākya dpal ba'i 'khor lo'i bri thabs dang*/ rje bla mas rgya gzhung gi 'khor lo'i man ngag la gsal ba mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung gi zhabs tog tu rab gnas kyi gsal byed dang*/ rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i 'don 'grigs cung zad bcas blo gter dbang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
